info.name: OpenChoreo - Members CRUD Demo
info.description: Run requests 01 through 09 in order. Select Local or OpenChoreo environment and set base_url without a trailing slash. Request 03 saves member_id for subsequent requests. PUT replaces the member fields; DELETE returns 204 with no body. In-memory data resets when the process restarts; use one replica.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Service is healthy", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql("ok"); });
pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("List and count agree", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(body.count).to.eql(body.data.length); });
pm.collectionVariables.unset("member_id");
pm.test("HTTP 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.collectionVariables.set("member_id", String(pm.response.json().data.id)); }

pm.test("Member created", function () { const member = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(member.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(member.name).to.eql("Charlie Fernando"); pm.expect(member.email).to.eql("charlie@example.com"); pm.expect(member.role).to.eql("member"); });
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")) { throw new Error("Send 03 - Add member first to capture member_id."); }
pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Correct member returned", function () { const member = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(String(member.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")); pm.expect(member.email).to.eql("charlie@example.com"); });
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")) { throw new Error("Send 03 - Add member first to capture member_id."); }
pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Member edited", function () { const member = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(String(member.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")); pm.expect(member.name).to.eql("Charlie Fernando Updated"); pm.expect(member.email).to.eql("charlie.updated@example.com"); pm.expect(member.role).to.eql("admin"); });
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")) { throw new Error("Send 03 - Add member first to capture member_id."); }
pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Edit was saved", function () { const member = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(String(member.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")); pm.expect(member.name).to.eql("Charlie Fernando Updated"); pm.expect(member.email).to.eql("charlie.updated@example.com"); pm.expect(member.role).to.eql("admin"); });
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")) { throw new Error("Send 03 - Add member first to capture member_id."); }
pm.test("HTTP 204", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test("Delete has no response body", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(""); });
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")) { throw new Error("Send 03 - Add member first to capture member_id."); }
pm.test("HTTP 404", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test("Member is gone", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("member not found"); });
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")) { throw new Error("Send 03 - Add member first to capture member_id."); }
pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Deleted member is absent", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.count).to.eql(body.data.length); const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("member_id")); pm.expect(body.data.some(function (member) { return member.id === id; })).to.eql(false); });
